parameters.controller: The scroll position, when the caller holds it.
parameters.height: Its height, for a vertical area in a page that scrolls itself.
parameters.width: Its width, for a sideways area in a row.
parameters.alwaysShown: Show the scrollbar whenever there is anything to scroll.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls the region.
parameters.shape: Chooses the outline of the component.
parameters.padding: Space round the content, inside the scrolling.
parameters.focusNode: The area's keyboard stop (the arrow and page keys scroll it).
parameters.autofocus: Whether it takes focus when it first shows.
